fields.rationale: Distributed data access must survive transient network and database faults without allowing stalled connections to cascade into system-wide exhaustion. Disabling silent provider-internal retries in favor of observable Polly retry and circuit-breaker policies ensures operators have full diagnostic visibility while leaving failover orchestration to infrastructure.
fields.statement: Recover gracefully from transient failures out of the box: automatic retries (with configurable count, interval, and lengthening curve) plus circuit breaking, provided via Polly, with sensible defaults that apply unless overridden anywhere in the configuration hierarchy. Retries and breaker trips must always be logged.
fields.title: Be resilient by default, and never hide it

sources.label: Resilience strategies — retries, circuit breaking, logged behavior, failover stance
